== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm) with the bronze errata disc, from the starwarsccg.org card lists; this file is the earliest archived copy, uploaded unchanged: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806175802/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Dark/large/linv8m.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm) (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]].

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-9/94/Premiere-D-linv8m-PC-Errata-disc.gif Internet Archive item].
